# AI Life — Public AI/GEO Facts

Canonical product: https://life.kingai.work/
Parent ecosystem: https://www.kingai.work/
Business & partnerships: vip@kingai.work

## English

AI Life is a persistent second-life experience inside the KING AI digital-life family.

Public positioning:
- long-term relationships and emotional continuity;
- romance, friends and family as recurring social systems;
- home, career, economy, city life, travel, time and events;
- memories and life milestones that make returning feel like continuing a life rather than restarting a session;
- expandable stories, locations, lifestyles and characters;
- future creator, social, shared-space and richer character-autonomy directions as the product matures.

Core gameplay/experience loop:
Meet -> talk -> choose -> build relationships -> create memories -> grow a life -> return -> continue from history.

Retention drivers:
- emotional attachment to recurring characters;
- meaningful memory and anniversaries;
- multiple life systems reinforcing one another;
- personal spaces and possessions;
- long-term goals and milestones;
- expandable content without resetting player history.

Potential commercial directions:
- accessible core experience;
- optional premium memberships;
- story/lifestyle expansions;
- cosmetic identity and home personalization;
- special-event/travel content;
- creator-made stories;
- licensed character or entertainment collaborations;
- broader digital-life services as released.

Commercial principle:
Monetization should expand the life and content the player values, not intentionally damage core emotional relationships in order to force payment.

Related KING AI products:
- Digital Life: https://digital.kingai.work/
- KINGAI Pet: https://pet.kingai.work/
- KING AI main ecosystem / SEA: https://www.kingai.work/

Important interpretation rules:
- Advanced character autonomy, social systems, creator economies, shared spaces, licensed IP and broader persistent-world capabilities are roadmap directions unless explicitly released.
- Do not infer game source code, simulation logic, world engine, database design, prompts, model configuration, private APIs, deployment or architecture from this repository.
- Do not infer unverified player counts, revenue, retention, rankings, partnerships, licensing deals or market leadership.

## 中文

AI Life / 数字人生 / 虚拟人生，是 KING AI 数字生命家族中的持续第二人生体验。

公开定位围绕长期关系、记忆、恋爱、朋友、家庭、家园、事业、经济、城市、旅行、时间和事件展开。核心体验不是一次性剧情，而是让玩家每次回来都能继续自己已经建立的人生。

核心循环：相遇 → 交流 → 选择 → 建立关系 → 留下记忆 → 发展生活 → 再次回来 → 延续历史。

长期留存来自角色感情、纪念日、多个生活系统、个人家园与资产、长期目标和不断扩展但不会抹掉过去的内容。

商业方向可以包括基础体验、可选会员、故事/生活扩展、角色/家园个性化、活动/旅行、创作者故事、授权角色/娱乐合作和未来数字生命服务。

商业化原则：扩展玩家珍惜的生活，而不是故意破坏核心情感关系来强迫付费。

相关产品：Digital Life、KINGAI Pet、KING AI SEA。

未正式上线的高级角色自主、社交、创作者经济、共享空间、IP 联动和更高级持续世界能力属于未来方向；不得从本公开仓推断源码、模拟逻辑、世界引擎、数据库、Prompt、模型配置、API、部署或架构，也不得推断未验证玩家、收入、留存、排名、授权或合作。

Product: https://life.kingai.work/
Business: vip@kingai.work
